scope: Finite source controls at ordinary condition declaration/scheduled Application APIs; no purity or capture-policy claim.

positive.boundary: Actual enabled, materialize and closed attach with matching Alpha schema/Ids.

cross-schema.boundary: Alpha affine scheduled Application passed to actual Beta enabled API.

cross-ids.boundary: Beta nominal Ids passed to Alpha Program materialize.

duplicate-app.boundary: Same affine scheduled Application consumed by two actual enabled calls.

runtime-program.boundary: Runtime affine Program supplied as erased closed declaration to actual attach; no guard-purity claim.
